title: High quality DNA extraction from Fungi (small scale)
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.exmbfk6

steps.title: Collect tissue and freeze
steps.instruction: Collect 10–20 mg of fungal tissue or spores into a 2 mL Eppendorf tube containing one metal bead. Lyse the material with liquid nitrogen in a precooled tissue lyser at 50 Hz for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer and add RNase T1 as described.

substeps.instruction: Mix Buffer A, Buffer B, and Buffer C in a 2.5 : 2.5 : 1 ratio and add PVP to a final concentration of 0.1 %.
Allow the buffer to cool to room temperature.
Add RNase T1 at a ratio of 1 µL RNase T1 per 1750 µL lysis buffer (1 : 1750 RNase T1 : lysis buffer).

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of the prepared lysis buffer to the frozen tissue powder, vortex briefly, then incubate at 64 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Cool lysate on ice
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Add potassium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL (0.2 vol) of 5 M potassium acetate (KAc) to the lysate, mix by inversion, and incubate on ice for up to 5 min.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed, for 10 min.

steps.title: Phenol/chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a fresh Eppendorf tube containing 500 µL (1 vol) phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (P/C/I) and mix by inversion for 2 min.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed, for 10 min.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 400 µL of the supernatant to a fresh Eppendorf tube containing 500 µL room‑temperature isopropanol.

steps.title: DNA precipitation incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, maximum speed, for 30 min.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry
steps.instruction: Perform two washes with 70 % ethanol followed by centrifugation steps, then remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol and invert several times to dislodge the pellet.
Repeat the ethanol wash and inversion.
Remove the supernatant with a pipette.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE buffer, flick the tube gently to mix (do not vortex), and store at –20 °C. One microliter of the extracted DNA can be used directly for PCR; if a larger amount of tissue was processed, dilute the DNA 10‑fold to 100‑fold before PCR.
